find_raw.episode_notes: A Telugu romantic comedy where Abhi conceals his wealthy background and goes by the name 'Vijay' to live near his crush Meera. His friend and family match Harshitha visits and threatens his cover before gracefully deciding not to interfere, just as his father tracks him down. Clipping the identity slips or father's search reveals the core deception central to the plot.

payoffs.reason: Harshitha casually blurts out 'నీ పేరు అభి కదా!' right in front of Meera, instantly putting Abhi's fake identity in immediate jeopardy.
Abhi hilariously breaks character while pretending to be an aggressive travel agent by snapping 'bags సర్దుకొని flight ఎక్కేయండి' to get rid of Harshitha.
Harshitha delivers a sharp wordplay pun on the word flat by praising both the apartment and the girl Abhi is infatuated with ('నువ్వు flat అయిన అమ్మాయి బాగుంది').
Harshitha covers up for their expensive schooling with an absurd deadpan excuse that their parents became poor by paying for their education ('మమ్మల్ని చదివించాకే poor అయిపోయాం').
Harshitha leaves Abhi with a resonant piece of relationship advice before bowing out gracefully: 'Love లో sincerity ఉండాలి, serious గా ఉంటే సరిపోదు'.
Right as Abhi boasts that nobody can come between him and Meera, his friend dryly bursts his bubble by stating that his secret wealth is the obvious obstacle.
Abhi's father angrily clarifies to the confused shopkeeper that he is looking for his son Abhi, not a grocery item ('Idiot, నా కొడుకు అభి కావాలి').
